claims: The Premier League record for most assists in a single season is 20.
Thierry Henry recorded 20 assists in the Premier League 2002/03 season for Arsenal.
Kevin De Bruyne recorded 20 assists in the Premier League 2019/20 season for Manchester City.
Ryan Giggs holds the all-time Premier League assist record with 162 assists.
Kevin De Bruyne has 119 all-time Premier League assists.
Cesc Fàbregas has 111 all-time Premier League assists.
Wayne Rooney has 103 all-time Premier League assists.
Frank Lampard has 102 all-time Premier League assists.
Mesut Özil recorded 19 assists in the Premier League 2015/16 season for Arsenal.
Bruno Fernandes has recorded 18 assists in the Premier League 2025/26 season for Manchester United as of April 18, 2026.
Mohamed Salah recorded 18 assists in the Premier League 2024/25 season for Liverpool.
Cesc Fàbregas recorded 18 assists in the Premier League 2014/15 season for Chelsea.
Frank Lampard recorded 18 assists in the Premier League 2004/05 season for Chelsea.
Kevin De Bruyne recorded 18 assists in the Premier League 2016/17 season for Manchester City.
As of April 18, 2026, Bruno Fernandes has 5 matches remaining in the 2025/26 Premier League season to break the single-season assists record of 20.
As of April 18, 2026, Bruno Fernandes is joint-second on the all-time Premier League single-season assists list alongside players like Frank Lampard and Kevin De Bruyne.
